title: Digital marketing in Poland for UK businesses | icomSEO

facts.fact: The vendor icomSEO states it has been in business since 2007.
facts.quote: Polish SEO and digital marketing agency · since 2007

facts.fact: The vendor states it has delivered more than 1,000 projects.
The vendor states it has about 30 or more specialists.
The vendor states it has run SEO and campaigns for clients in 25 markets across Europe, North America and Australia.
facts.quote: We have run SEO and campaigns for clients in 25 markets across Europe, North America and Australia.

facts.fact: The vendor states it runs SEO and campaigns in more than 10 languages.
facts.quote: languages in which we run SEO and campaigns

facts.fact: The vendor reports a 228% increase in enquiries from foreign markets for its client Poland Premium.
facts.quote: enquiries from foreign markets for our client Poland Premium

facts.fact: icomSEO's own Google reviews profile shows a 5.0 out of 5 rating from 60 Google reviews, with data shown as of 12/10/2026.
The icomSEO Group Google reviews profile shows a 4.7 out of 5 rating from 190 Google reviews, with data shown as of 12/10/2026.
The page states that Poland has around 37 million inhabitants.
The page states that the UK is outside the EU and has its own customs and VAT rules, while Poland is an EU member state in the single market and customs union.
facts.quote: Outside the EU, with its own customs and VAT rules

facts.fact: The page lists the UK currency as GBP and the Polish currency as PLN, with domains .co.uk and .pl respectively.
The page recommends preparing prices in zloty (PLN) when entering Poland.
The page names BLIK as a payment method Polish customers prefer.
facts.quote: the payment methods Polish customers prefer, such as BLIK

facts.fact: The page states that icomSEO presents campaign results in a report every month.
facts.quote: present them every month in a clear report

facts.fact: The page states that for Google Ads work the ad account stays with the client.
The page states that, depending on the market, icomSEO optimises for Bing or Seznam besides Google.
facts.quote: Besides Google, depending on the market, Bing or Seznam.

facts.fact: The page states that icomSEO is a Google Partner.
The page lists Consent Mode v2 among its analytics and tracking services, stated to be in line with GDPR.
facts.quote: GA4, Google Tag Manager and Consent Mode v2 in line with GDPR.
